info.name: Adfluence API
info.description:
Adfluence backend API collection.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/v1

**Setup**
1. Import `Adfluence.postman_environment.json` (optional)
2. Run **Auth → Login** — tokens auto-save to collection variables
3. Protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`

**Admin:** `make seed-admin` then use **Admin → Login** (`portal: admin`)

**Rate limits:** Login lockout after 5 failed attempts (5m → 30m → 2h). Forgot password: 3/hour/email.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication — signup, login, tokens, password reset, email verify (OTP).

request.description: Register a business account. Returns tokens + redirect_to.
Login business/influencer. Optional `next` = safe internal path override. Saves tokens automatically.
Always 200 generic message. Max 3/hour per email. Check email or server logs for reset link.
Set `resetToken` from email link query param `?token=`
Sends 6-digit OTP to user email. Max 3/hour.
Set verifyOtp from email (6 digits, 5 min expiry).
Sends 6-digit OTP via SMS (or logs to server console in dev). Max 3/hour.
Set verifyOtp from SMS or server console log (6 digits, 5 min expiry).

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin portal — seed with `make seed-admin`. Same login endpoint with portal: admin.

request.description: Requires seeded admin. Non-admin users get 403 not_admin.

item.name: Chat & Messaging
item.description: Real-time WebSocket & PostgreSQL chat APIs — 1-on-1 messaging, read receipts, dual-mode deletion, conversation summaries.

request.description: Get or create a 1-on-1 conversation with an influencer or business. Auto-saves conversationId to collection variables.
List all active conversations for the authenticated user, ordered by most recent message, with counterpart profile and unread count.
Fetch metadata, unread count, and counterpart info for a specific conversation.
Send a message over REST (fallback to WebSocket). Automatically triggers real-time WebSocket event to receiver. Auto-saves messageId.

query.description: Optional message ID cursor to fetch older messages before this point (infinite scroll)

request.description: Cursor-based chat history. Pass `cursor=<oldest_message_id>` to fetch older history when scrolling up. Automatically hides soft-deleted messages.
Marks all received messages in the conversation as read and broadcasts real-time read receipt to the sender.

query.description: either 'me' (delete for self) or 'everyone' (tombstone for both)

request.description: Deletes message with dual modes: 'me' (private deletion) or 'everyone' (WhatsApp/Telegram style tombstone).

Connect via WebSocket client (e.g. Postman WebSocket Request, wscat, or browser):

URL: `ws://localhost:8080/api/v1/chat/ws?token=<accessToken>`

Incoming JSON format:
```json
{
  "type": "send_message",
  "conversation_id": "{{conversationId}}",
  "body": "Real-time message text"
}
```
